title: Hexagonal numbers
statementMd:
Hexagonal numbers are figurate numbers which can be calculated using the formula $*h*_{*n*} = 2*n*^{2} - *n*$. You are given $*n*$; calculate $*n*$-th hexagonal number.

## Input

The only line of input contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$).

## Output

Output the $*n*$-th hexagonal number.
